title: What Should a Work Resume Template Look Like?
excerpt: In academic resumes I said keep it plain. For work resumes, a slightly attractive template might actually catch attention, especially with smaller Iranian companies.

blocks.text: What Should a Work Resume Template Look Like?
In the academic section I had complete talks about resume templates and I provided you with various sites and templates along with links.
There I had a very firm and strict tone that you should absolutely not use designed and colorful templates and it's not professional.
For a work resume I'm still standing by this word and my own personal preference is not using colorful and designed resumes, but there's one point:

For work resumes, I'm not that firm and strict that the template must be simple. Especially if you want to send a resume to companies inside Iran that are neither that big nor that famous, maybe even using a template that has an attractive look could catch their attention.
I just wanted to clarify this point here.
The rest of the links and tools were also mentioned in the academic resume section and I don't feel like writing them again 😁
